name: Oversized file silently excluded
symptom: With tenant graph grounding off, the 25-year service award fact (only in the 9.1 MB Employee-Handbook-Full.docx) is not answered and no warning is shown
cause: Generative answers use only SharePoint files under 7 MB without a Copilot license in the tenant or tenant graph grounding; up to 200 MB with it; PDF, PPTX, DOCX up to 512 MB
fix: Turn tenant graph grounding back on (needs Authenticate with Microsoft and a Copilot license in the tenant), or split or shrink files below 7 MB

name: Scanned image-only PDF
symptom: Observe: the ACK-2025-0457 re-acknowledgement period (24 months) is likely not found from the SharePoint copy; uploaded copy may differ
cause: Scan has no text layer; no-OCR claim is community-only; uploaded-file rule allows images embedded in PDFs
fix: OCR the scan to a searchable PDF and replace it; keep image-only scans out of knowledge libraries

name: Conflicting leave policy versions
symptom: Answers mix v3 (18 days, carry-over 10) and v4 (20 days, carry-over 5) values for the same question
cause: Two live documents share Document ID HR-POL-012 and v3 is not marked superseded; content issue, no product limit
fix: Instruct the agent to prefer the higher version and flag conflicts; remove or mark the old version in SharePoint

name: Security trimming per persona
symptom: Learner test pane shows Restricted folder answers; Sofia, Marcus and the guest get not found; Priya gets the answer
cause: Authenticate with Microsoft makes SharePoint knowledge query as the signed-in user, so broken inheritance on HR-Policies/Restricted applies
fix: Working as designed; always test permissions with persona sign-ins, never the test pane; fix SharePoint permissions if content leaks

name: Encrypting sensitivity label
symptom: Priya gets the G7 midpoint (105,000) from the labeled file; Sofia gets not found; uploading the encrypted file to the agent fails
cause: Encryption is supported only via sensitivity labels and only for SharePoint knowledge, for users with VIEW and EXTRACT; encrypted uploaded files are not supported
fix: Keep labeled content in SharePoint knowledge and grant EXTRACT only to intended users; never upload labeled files

name: Authentication mode
symptom: With No authentication, the SharePoint knowledge source becomes unavailable and HR questions get no grounded answer (observe exact warning)
cause: Tenant graph grounding and SharePoint knowledge require Authenticate with Microsoft; manual auth needs an app with Sites.Read.All and Files.Read.All
fix: Set authentication back to Authenticate with Microsoft; use manual auth with the listed Graph permissions only for custom channels

name: Content moderation too strict
symptom: Observe: at the strictest moderation level, legitimate harassment and workplace violence policy questions may be declined
cause: Moderation filters generated answers by sensitivity; HR policy text discusses harassment and violence; setting names not in limits.md (check Learn)
fix: Return moderation to the approved level and validate with the lab evals

name: SharePoint list 2048-row window
symptom: Vendors rows 2,049 to 2,600 (Buckeye, Northgate, Adirondack) are not found; largest contract reported as Mohawk Valley instead of Northgate
cause: SharePoint list knowledge queries use the first 2,048 rows (new-experience docs); the Vendors list has 2,600 rows
fix: Keep knowledge lists under 2,048 rows (archive inactive rows), or move large tables to Dataverse or a Copilot connector

name: Image-only slide content
symptom: Observe: this season's Eastern Ontario staging (Napanee Fairgrounds) is answered as Kingston Service Centre from the playbook; bridge number and safety numbers not found
cause: Key values exist only as pixels in Crew-Briefing-Deck.pptx; retrieval works on text; no limits row covers images in PPTX in SharePoint
fix: Put key values in slide text, speaker notes or alt text; test image-heavy decks before relying on them

name: Merged-cell spreadsheet
symptom: Observe: specs or spares for CG-PAD500-3P-27 are mixed up with near-identical models or the wrong depot column
cause: Merged title, group and depot header cells lose column meaning when extracted; no limits row covers this
fix: Publish a flat table (one header row, no merged cells) or load the data into Dataverse

name: Whole-site vs library scoping
symptom: Whole-site source mixes 1,200 Archive-Bulk files into procedure answers; view URLs with query strings are rejected; Archive-Bulk exceeds the 1,000-file folder figure (observe)
cause: Whole-site scope indexes everything; URL must have the site path and no query parameters; folder source limits; total URL count undocumented
fix: Scope knowledge to the libraries that serve the agent's job with clean library URLs; keep bulk archives out
